title: Audit explicit currency/date consistency and indicative FX
reason: User payments specify amount,currency and date; AdventureWorks Currency/CurrencyRate specify pair and date. Proposed currency validity intervals and same-date ECB quotes can expose withdrawn codes or compare fixture rates with indicative reference rates. Derive USD crossrates only with explicit quote orientation and shared publication date. Visuals: validity timeline,rate ratio chart,missing-rate grid. AW DEM/FRF during2022–2025 are source conflicts,not accepted matches. SIX withdrawal month differs from CLDR tender interval; rights and rate semantics unresolved. No other demo receives an invented currency.
practical_value: Proposed connected bundle; identity, temporal, legal and match-rate review required. Not selected or implemented.
showcase_value: Named visualisations support the questions; practical joinability dominates.
